article.title: нельзя + infinitivo
article.part: Voz e infinitivo — Залог и инфинитив
article.chapter: Infinitivo, control y modalidad — Инфинитив, контроль и модальность

claims.sectionKey: La construcción нельзя + infinitivo expresa que una acción es imposible o está prohibida
claims.summary: The construction нельзя + infinitive expresses that an action is impossible or prohibited.

claims.sectionKey: En ‘Здесь нельзя курить’ — ‘Aquí no se puede fumar / Está prohibido fumar’
claims.summary: In ‘Здесь нельзя курить’ — ‘Aquí no se puede fumar / Está prohibido fumar’, нельзя presents the action of курить as not allowed in that place.

claims.sectionKey: El aspecto del infinitivo depende del significado
claims.summary: The aspect of the infinitive depends on the meaning.

links.notes: The Wikipedia article on Aspect (grammar) provides a clear explanation of the construction нельзя + infinitive, stating that it expresses impossibility or prohibition of an action. This directly supports the claim made in the article.

The same Wikipedia article explains that нельзя is used to indicate prohibition or imposibility of an action in a specific context. The example given, ‘Здесь нельзя курить’, directly illustrates this usage, supporting the claim made in the article.

The Wikipedia article explains that the aspect of the infinitive (imperfective or perfective) depends on the meaning of the sentence. This supports the claim in the article that the aspect of the infinitive can vary based on the context and the meaning of the action.
